value.rationale: The graph is the canonical smallest three-axis cross-polytope graph, with a full order-48 signed-permutation symmetry group. The known Betti number 675 cannot answer whether symmetry-invariant rational homology exists or how central inversion acts. The exact ten-irreducible classification proves 11 fixed classes and a nontrivial 325/350 eigenspace split, furnishing a concrete natural equivariant-topology invariant and reusable character benchmark. It is a motivated complete finite classification, not an arbitrary parameter slice or merely a code consistency test.
